description.description: A concise description (50-70 words) of the lever's purpose, scope, and key success metrics. Add new insight beyond what consequences and review already state.

synergy_text.description: A brief text (20-40 words) naming one or two other levers this lever amplifies or enables, and why.

conflict_text.description: A brief text (20-40 words) naming one or two other levers this lever constrains or trades off against, and why.
conflict_text.title: Conflict Text
